exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
Women who had a repeat cesarean delivery without trial of labor
trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
cohort: 167 adolescent women aged ≤21 years with a history of 1 previous cesarean delivery, who delivered in 2 tertiary medical centers during 2007-2019
finding: TOLAC in adolescent women with previous cesarean delivery had a high success rate (83%), with low birthweight being independently associated with TOLAC failure.
mod_finding: Trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC) in adolescent women who had never delivered vaginally was associated with a relatively high success rate.
gest_age: Median 38 weeks (TOLAC group) vs 39 weeks (repeat cesarean group)
